contact.area: Atlanta metro area, or online from anywhere

footerLine: Italian and Spanish lessons, French for beginners · adults, teens and kids · Atlanta metro area and online

cta.label: Free · 15 minutes · no obligation
cta.title: Start with a free 15-minute call
cta.text: Tell me why you want to learn. By the end of the call you know your level, the format that fits your week and what the first month looks like. Then you decide.
cta.fine: [CONFIRM] One teacher means a limited number of students. If my week is full, I’ll tell you when the next place opens.

rhythm: I suggest two hours a week. Enough to make real progress, light enough to keep up.

formats.title: Just you, or a small group?

options.title: One-on-one
options.text: The whole lesson is built around you: your goals and your pace.

options.title: Small group
options.text: You practice with each other, and the lesson stays personal.

options.title: In person
options.text: In the Atlanta metro area, at a place that works for both of us.

options.title: Online
options.text: Same lessons, on video. Good when you are short on time or outside the Atlanta area.

formatsNote: Any mix works: one-on-one online, a small group in person, or the other way round.
levelsText: Every Italian, Spanish and French lesson is matched to your level and your age. Italian and Spanish run from beginner to business level. French is for beginners. Not sure where you stand? The [free 15-minute call](#contact) sorts that out.

levels.title: Beginners
levels.text: You start from zero, or from a few words you already know.

levels.title: Intermediate
levels.text: You get by. Now you build real conversation.

levels.title: Advanced
levels.text: Fluency, nuance and the culture behind the words.

levels.title: Business
levels.text: Meetings, calls and email in the language you work in.

ages.title: Adults
ages.text: For work, travel, family or the pleasure of it.

ages.title: Teens
ages.text: Alongside school, at their own pace.

ages.title: Kids
ages.text: Lessons built around their age and what they like.

reviews.quote: [EXAMPLE] I had three years of Italian on an app and could not get through a coffee order. Two months in with Valentina, I spent a week in Puglia and never switched to English.
reviews.name: [EXAMPLE] Sarah M., Decatur

reviews.quote: [EXAMPLE] My daughter is eleven and used to dread Spanish at school. Now she asks when Valentina is coming, and she corrects my accent at dinner.
reviews.name: [EXAMPLE] Daniel R., Sandy Springs

reviews.quote: [EXAMPLE] I run a team in Monterrey and used to hide behind email. We practiced my real Monday call, line by line. Now I open the meeting in Spanish.
reviews.name: [EXAMPLE] Priya K., online from Charlotte
